mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a mild 58 degrees with overcast skies as you look out toward the Military Ridge State Trail. We are currently under a Waxing Gibbous moon, though there are no visible ISS passes scheduled for tonight.

For our city update, the student I Voted sticker contest has officially closed for entries. We are looking forward to the public voting period which runs from July 28 through August 7, where designs from four age categories will compete to be featured on stickers for the November election.

We have a packed schedule of local entertainment. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market will be at the Capitol Square, and live music is scheduled at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock; the driver was subsequently arrested for an O-W-I.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich and delicious Chocolate Volcano. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open at 10 AM.
